cc:Work.dc:title: transient-transport convergence
cc:Work.dc:description: transient-transport; all 6 measured levels; fixed final-four diagnostic window. Native local P2/r2; P1 traces; capacity one, diffusion one; smooth fixed convection/reaction; c=t sin(pi x) sin(pi y). All six composite rows n=4,8,16,24,32,48; H=sqrt(2)/n; dt=0.01,T=0.5 with separate halved-time control. Analytical physical concentration and broken gradient errors; temporal/spatial studies separately controlled. Record examples/results/tutorial-methods/transient-spatial-asymptotic.json; SHA256 6315111e91732fc3d7e28159b1ed74447ee4b98673606330af63734ea534b6a0. Araya et al. (2024), theorems 2–3 and assumption A2: smooth energy order ell+1; concentration order three observed; independent time-step control. CC BY 4.0 — IPES Research Group; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
